steps.label: Talk to Scott
steps.objective: Talk to Lt Scott in the Gate Room.

steps.label: Find Rush
steps.objective: Head to the Control Interface Room — before Rush does something reckless.

steps.label: Explore the ship
steps.objective: Cool off. Explore the ship — find your way to the Kino room.

steps.label: Inspect the strange device
steps.objective: There's a strange device on your desk. Take a look.

steps.label: Sleep
steps.objective: Get some rest. Lay down on the bed in your quarters.

steps.label: Return to the Control Room
steps.objective: Scott's orders: get to the Control Interface Room and find Rush.

steps.label: Access a control terminal
steps.objective: Access a control terminal in the Control Interface Room.

steps.label: Find CO2 scrubber
steps.objective: Talk to Dr Rush at the open life-support panel in the south corridor.

steps.label: Trigger FTL drop
steps.objective: Return to the Gate Room and trigger the FTL drop.

steps.label: Get to the Gate Room
steps.objective: Dr Brody says the gate dialed itself. Get to the Gate Room.

steps.label: Fetch a Kino
steps.objective: We can't risk going in blind. Grab a Kino from the dispenser in your quarters.

steps.label: Send a Kino through the gate
steps.objective: Back at the gate: open the Kino Remote (Tab) and launch a Kino through to scout the planet.

steps.label: Dial lime planet
steps.objective: Use Gate Control in the Gate Room to dial the lime planet.

steps.label: Mine lime
steps.objective: Step through the Stargate and mine lime on the planet.

steps.label: Return to Destiny
steps.objective: Return through the planet gate to Destiny.

steps.label: Repair CO2 scrubber
steps.objective: Bring lime to the CO2 scrubber in the south corridor.

steps.label: Episode complete
steps.objective: Episode 1: Air — Complete

steps.label: Find the Engineering Bay
steps.objective: With the air crisis resolved, power is still intermittent. Find the Engineering Bay — it should be somewhere near the aft sections of the ship.

steps.label: Locate the conduit junction
steps.objective: Inside Engineering, find the power conduit junction. It's the main distribution point for the ship's power grid.

steps.label: Repair the junction
steps.objective: The conduit junction is damaged. Repair it to restore generator output to the grid.

steps.label: Route power to critical rooms
steps.objective: With the junction repaired, route power to the Gate Room and Control Interface Room. Use the junction panel to distribute power.

steps.label: Unlock more of the ship
steps.objective: With critical systems online, salvage parts from broken panels and unlock the next deck of Destiny via the floor terminal.

steps.label: Exploration underway
steps.objective: The ship's secrets are yours to uncover.

steps.label: Deploy with the squad
steps.objective: Gate Room — Greer and Dr Park are ready to deploy. Step through the Stargate with your squad.

steps.label: Find resources
steps.objective: Scan the surface for mineral deposits and water sources. Use squad commands to coordinate your team.

steps.label: Investigate Ancient ruins
steps.objective: Ancient ruins were detected near the gate. Investigate them for any useful technology.

steps.label: Retrieve Ancient technology
steps.objective: Recover any Ancient device found in the ruins. Rush will want to study it.

steps.label: Return through the gate
steps.objective: Mission objectives complete. Get back to the gate before the window closes.

steps.label: Mission complete
steps.objective: Planetary mission complete. The squad returned safely with resources and Ancient technology.

steps.label: Find the communication stones
steps.objective: Rush mentioned Ancient communication stones in the observation deck. Find them.

steps.label: Activate the stones
steps.objective: Place your hand on the stone pedestal. The Ancients built them to speak across the void.

steps.label: Report to Stargate Command
steps.objective: You're on Earth in another body. Find SGC personnel and deliver your report.

steps.label: Return to Destiny
steps.objective: Your report is delivered. Use the stone to return to your body on Destiny.

steps.label: Earth contact established
steps.objective: Episode 5: Earth — Complete. The link to Earth is established.

steps.label: Check in with the crew
steps.objective: Things have been tense. Visit the crew — see who needs help.

steps.label: Help TJ with medical supplies
steps.objective: TJ needs help finding medical supplies in the lower deck storage. She's in the med bay.

steps.label: Help Camille mediate between factions
steps.objective: Camille needs someone to carry messages between Young, Rush, and the civilians. Find her on the observation deck.

steps.label: Reach out to Greer
steps.objective: Greer's been on edge. Someone needs to get through to him. Find him in the gate room.

steps.label: Life — Complete
steps.objective: Episode 6: Life — Complete. You've deepened your bonds with the crew.

steps.label: Talk to Camille
steps.objective: Camille wants to talk. She's in the mess hall — she says it's important.

steps.label: The food shortage crisis
steps.objective: Rations are running low. The civilians are hungry. Camille demands a vote on distribution. Make a choice.

steps.label: Talk to Rush
steps.objective: Rush has been acting strange. Find him in the control interface room.

steps.label: Rush's secret project
steps.objective: Eli discovers Rush has been accessing the ship's master code after hours. Confront him — or report him to Young.

steps.label: The civilian protest
steps.objective: Camille leads civilians to occupy the mess hall. The military is surrounding them. Mediate — or take a side.

steps.label: The Lucian Alliance threat
steps.objective: Varro brings intelligence about Simeon's secret activities. Decide who to trust.

steps.label: The final standoff
steps.objective: The ship is divided. Rush has locked himself in the control room. Young is preparing to breach. Your choice will decide who controls Destiny.

steps.label: Episode 12: Divided — Complete
steps.objective: The mutiny is over. Destiny's fate has been decided.

steps.label: Investigate the crime scene
steps.objective: Dr Ginn has been found dead in the Engineering Bay. Examine the scene.

steps.label: Gather evidence
steps.objective: Search the Engineering Bay for clues. Deploy a Kino to find hidden evidence.

steps.label: Talk to Dr Rush
steps.objective: Rush mentioned Ginn came to him with concerns. Question him in the Control Interface Room.

steps.label: Interrogate the suspects
steps.objective: Question the suspects. Use a Kino during interrogation to detect lies.

steps.label: Verify Varro's alibi
steps.objective: Varro claims he was in the mess hall. Check with Camille to verify.

steps.label: Confront Simeon
steps.objective: The evidence points to Simeon. Confront him with what you know.

steps.label: Make your accusation
steps.objective: Present your case to Colonel Young. Choose carefully — a wrong accusation will tear the crew apart.

steps.label: Justice served
steps.objective: Episode 7: Justice — Complete. The murderer has been brought to justice.

steps.label: Red Alert
steps.objective: The alarm sounds. Lucian Alliance ships have dropped out of FTL alongside Destiny. Get to the gate room.

steps.label: Defend the ship
steps.objective: Enemy ships are firing on Destiny. Man the defense systems and survive the bombardment.

steps.label: Repel the boarders
steps.objective: Enemy soldiers have breached the hull. Fight them off in the corridors. Multiple waves incoming.

steps.label: Hold the key rooms
steps.objective: Hold the gate room, control interface, and infirmary. If the enemy captures too many rooms, all is lost.

steps.label: The offer
steps.objective: Kiva offers terms: surrender the Destiny and live, or fight on and risk everything. Choose carefully.

steps.label: Cliffhanger
steps.objective: As the dust settles, Destiny drops out of FTL. Something impossible appears on the sensors.

steps.label: Trapped in the nebula
steps.objective: Destiny dropped out of FTL inside a nebula. Power is draining. Get to the Control Interface Room.

steps.label: Conserve power
steps.objective: Choose which systems to power down. Every system off saves power — but costs something the crew needs.

steps.label: Low-power planet mission
steps.objective: A planet with resources is in range. Deploy with limited Kino and no sprint. Collect resources to jump-start the engines.

steps.label: Escape the nebula
steps.objective: With resources secured, reroute power to the engines and break free of the nebula.

steps.label: Darkness — Complete
steps.objective: Episode 4: Darkness — Complete. Destiny escapes the nebula.
